units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>לך כ׳</he> unto thee is bending due.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Ib.</cite> <he>תזקפנו מכְּפִיפָתֵינוּ</he> erect us from our humiliation.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65a:14">Snh. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>כְּפִיפַת קומתו</he> bending one’s body (before the idol).

<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:6">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (ref. to the shape of certain letters, v. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>) <he>הוסיף … כ׳ על כְּפִיפָתוֹ</he> the Lord has given thee repeated admonitions to humility, v. <cite ref="M01736"><he>מָנוֹד</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (v. קְפִיפָה; cmp. Assyr. kuppu, Schr. KAT2, p. 582) cage, prison.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 72a">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין אדם דר עם נחש בכ׳</he> nobody can be expected to dwell in a cage with a serpent, i.e. no man or woman can be compelled to live with an obnoxious consort.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:9">Tosef. Dem. III, 9</cite>; Y. ib. II, 22ᵈ bot.

senses.gloss: [muzzle, in gen.] a basket of osier, v. זְמָמָא.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:1">Kel. XXVI, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ מצרית</he> a basket made of palm twigs; <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 2:1">Sot. II, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:7:9">Y. Yoma VIII, end, 45ᶜ</cite> <he>אין … מתוך כ׳ וכ׳</he> an ass brays only when a basket of carobs is before him, i.e. living in plenty makes haughty, cmp.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 5:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. V, 8</cite> Var., v. <cite ref="K01022"><he>כְּפִישָׁה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּפִיפוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 9:3">Ter. IX, 3</cite> <he>תולה כ׳ וכ׳</he> we may muzzle beasts by hanging baskets with fodder &c.; Y. ib. IX, 46ᵈ top <he>תולה כ׳ … בדישו</he> you may hang a basket over the neck of a beast in threshing.
